description: Defines the XBitmapImage class, a pixel-based bitmap image class in the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace. It includes constructors and static factory methods for creating bitmap instances, with platform-specific code conditional compilation.

classes.name: XBitmapImage
classes.description: A sealed class representing a pixel-based bitmap image, inheriting from XBitmapSource. It handles bitmap creation with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: XBitmapImage
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing a new bitmap image with specified width and height, platform-specific code manages image creation.

methods.name: CreateBitmap
methods.description: Static factory method to create a default 24-bit ARGB bitmap with specified dimensions.
